title: H4 fix round 6: executor tracks the fallback worker threads it spawns so tests (and shutdown) can join them; the reservation hand-off test joins the thread instead of racing the next test on the shared state file (review T-0406)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain ade6b74, 530c2ab, c1ba47c, aca3bb2, d54104f, a214aaf and f3ef147 (T-0362 lineage through T-0404) in git log; never drop or amend them.
Review T-0406 on T-0404, one high finding: the full gate fails intermittently (exit 2 reproduced) in tests/test_executor.py::test_fallback_handoff_keeps_reservation_until_worker_finishes with AssertionError 'T-0010' unexpectedly found in the reservation set. Root cause: executor._exhausted() starts the fallback worker with threading.Thread(daemon=True).start() and never joins or exposes it; in the full suite a still-running thread from an earlier test writes the shared reservation PERSIST file after a later test has recreated it and reused the same sequential task id.
Fix: (1) executor keeps a registry of fallback worker threads it starts (module-level list or a small helper: executor.fallback_threads(), executor.join_fallback_threads(timeout)); _exhausted appends the thread; the registry drops finished threads. (2) The test suite's executor tests join the registry in tearDown (or the harness base class does) so no background worker outlives its test; the hand-off test asserts the reservation is present while the worker is blocked on an event, then releases the event, joins, and asserts a single release. (3) daemon shutdown (the stop path added in T-0386) joins the registry with a bounded timeout so the process does not exit mid-write. No behaviour change for production dispatch otherwise. Prove it: python -m unittest tests.test_executor twice, then .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root twice in a row, exit 0 both times. git add -A and commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows f3ef147 and the rest of the T-0362 lineage below your commit

tests/test_executor.py::test_fallback_handoff_keeps_reservation_until_worker_finishes passes deterministically (two consecutive full-suite runs) and joins the worker thread through the executor registry
executor exposes the fallback thread registry and a bounded join used by the tests' tearDown and by the daemon stop path (grep)
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree on two consecutive runs
